newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson gains three pct on Intel report.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson gains three pct on Intel report.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB jumped almost three percent after Intel Corp's stronger than expected third quarter earnings report on Monday, brokers said.
At 1335 GMT the share traded at 178 crowns, up five.
Intel Corp., powered by strong sales of its Pentium processor, reported a 40 percent jump in third quarter profits Monday, surpassing even the most optimistic Wall Street estimates.

"When Motorola's bad report came, Ericsson rose. Investors did not believe that Ericsson was affected by Motorola's semi-conductors business. Now Intel presents a good report and it's also good for Ericsson," one broker said.
"It's crazy, but that's the way it is," he said.
Brokers said trade was not especially heavy.
